settings.title: How it works — sending your photo
settings.content: For personalised pieces: after checkout, reply to your order confirmation email with your favourite photo of your pet. Daylight, eye level, and both eyes visible make the best illustrations.

settings.title: Sizing & fit
settings.content: Bandanas: 20″ × 10″ fits cats and small-to-medium dogs; 27″ × 13″ fits bigger pups. Apparel is a relaxed unisex fit — size up for extra cosy.

settings.title: Shipping & production
settings.content: Every piece is drawn and made to order, so please allow a few days for the studio before dispatch or download delivery. Free UK shipping on orders over £50.

settings.giveback_text: Made to order by a small studio 🎨
